summary_zh.动机: 开发并实验验证混合SLM与CNC铣削系统。
summary_zh.方法: 设计并搭建混合制造平台，进行工艺验证。
summary_zh.结果: 系统能够实现增材与减材复合制造。
summary_zh.验证: 实验测试系统性能与加工精度。

summary_en.motivation: To develop and experimentally validate a hybrid system combining selective laser melting and CNC milling for enhanced manufacturing capabilities.
summary_en.method: The hybrid platform was designed and built, integrating SLM and CNC modules, and process validation was performed.
summary_en.result: The system demonstrated successful hybrid manufacturing with improved surface finish and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted through testing of the system's mechanical performance and machining quality.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V多孔晶格结构力学性能的影响，与用户关注的应力遮挡和刚度匹配问题相关。

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V晶格材料微观结构和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备SLM晶格结构并进行不同热处理，结合微观表征和力学测试
summary_zh.result: 热处理提高了材料延展性，改变了失效模式
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态力学测试验证性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V lattice materials.
summary_en.method: Lattice structures were fabricated by selective laser melting, subjected to various heat treatments, and characterized by microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment enhanced ductility and altered failure modes of the lattice materials.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through quasi-static mechanical testing.

papers.title: In Situ Mo(Si,Al)2-Based Composite through Selective Laser Melting of a MoSi2-30 wt.% AlSi10Mg Mixture
papers.abstract: The laser power bed fusion approach has been successfully employed to manufacture Mo(Si,Al)2-based composites through the selective laser melting of a MoSi2-30 wt.% AlSi10Mg mixture for high-temperature structural applications. Composites were manufactured by leveraging the in situ reaction of the components during printing at 150–300 W laser power, 500–1000 mm·s−1 laser scanning speed, and 100–134 J·mm−3 volumetric energy density. Microcomputed tomography scans indicated a negligible induced porosity throughout the specimens. The fully dense Mo(Si1-x,Alx)2-based composites, with hardness exceeding 545 HV1 and low roughness for both the top (horizontal) and side (vertical) surfaces, demonstrated that laser-based additive manufacturing can be exploited to create unique structures containing hexagonal Mo(Si0.67Al0.33)2.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on high-temperature structural composites.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用激光熔化制备Mo(Si,Al)2基复合材料用于高温结构。
summary_zh.method: 选区激光熔化MoSi2-30%AlSi10Mg混合物，利用原位反应。
summary_zh.result: 获得完全致密、硬度>545 HV1、低粗糙度的复合材料。
summary_zh.validation: 显微CT和硬度测试验证致密性和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate Mo(Si,Al)2-based composites for high-temperature structural applications via additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of a MoSi2-30 wt.% AlSi10Mg mixture, leveraging in situ reaction during printing.
summary_en.result: Fully dense composites with hardness exceeding 545 HV1 and low surface roughness were achieved.
summary_en.validation: Microcomputed tomography and hardness testing confirmed near-full density and mechanical properties.
